description: Destroy one of an organization's release policies by name. A change to a policy applies to releases not yet decided. Changing a policy's enforcement or settings never changes a decided evaluation, and a running policy evaluation keeps the checker and enforcement it started with. A running policy evaluation whose checker hasn't started yet uses the current settings. Removing a policy, or changing its checker, cancels its running policy evaluations, so releases that waited only on it go ahead. Confirm with the user first. Past evaluations stay on the releases they evaluated. Destroying a policy that is already gone changes nothing. Requires connecting a Valet account. Requires the Admin role.

org_name.description: The Valet organization the policy belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

policy.description: The policy's name, as list_policies reports it.

name: destroy_policy

already_gone.description: True when the thing was already gone before the call, so nothing was destroyed. Absent when this call destroyed it.

kind.description: What the thing was, such as channel, connector, or resource.

name.description: Name of the thing the call destroyed, as the caller gave it.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

title: Destroy a release policy
